描述_EN: the figure's head is movable. this is the figure of an attendant wearing a red hat, right hand resting on waist, standing on a rectangular plinth, the body made of pottery with cold-painted aubergine pigment. this type of earthenware figure was mass-produced to be buried with the deceased.
描述_ZN: 该人物的头部是可移动的。 这是一个戴着红帽子的侍者的形象，右手放在腰间，站在一个长方形的基座上，身体由冷漆茄子色的陶器制成。 这种陶俑是大量生产的，与死者一起埋葬。
